title: New dataset: amharichatespeechranlp
description:
Introduction
	

The Amharic Hate Speech data is collected using the Twitter API spanning from October 1, 2020 - November 30, 2022, considering the socio-political dynamics of Ethiopia in Twitter space. We used WebAnno tool for data annotation; each tweet is annotated by two native speakers and curated by one more experienced adjudicator to determine the gold labels. A total of 15.1k tweets consisting of three class labels namely: Hate, Offensive and Normal are presented. title: New dataset: Amharic_corpus_split
description:
Amharic Corpus — 4 x 5k Splits
	

A randomly shuffled subset of Reubencf/Amharic_corpus,
divided into four equal splits of 5,000 rows each (20,000 rows total).

Splits: split_1, split_2, split_3, split_4 (5,000 rows each)
Format: JSON Lines, one {"text": "..."} per line.
Sampling: random without replacement (seed 42); the four splits are mutually exclusive.

from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("Reubencf/Amharic_corpus_split")
print(ds)  # split_1..split_4, 5000 rows… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Reubencf/Amharic_corpus_split.

title: New dataset: Amharic_corpus
description:
Amharic Corpus (JSON)
	

Amharic text corpus, 707,649 rows, one document per row.

Format: JSON Lines (amh_data.jsonl) — one {"text": "..."} object per line.
Column: text (string)
Language: Amharic (am)
License: MIT

Originally distributed as a plain-text file; here it is provided as line-delimited JSON.

	
		
	
	
		Usage
	

from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("Reubencf/Amharic_corpus")
print(ds["train"][0]["text"])
